lane_split.parallel_lane: V12 state-entry / prospective shadow CLI and export contracts
lane_split.this_lane: V14 drift diagnosis -> V15 regime-normalized representation

parent.motivation: V14 outcome-free audit found material covariate shift in absolute volatility/state features

removed_from_model_representation.rationale: candidate-generation paths stay V12 unchanged, but model representation is path-agnostic and avoids features that were moderate/severe in the frozen outcome-free V14 drift audit

normalized_replacements.history_scope: previous 20 complete causal bins for same symbol and same bin_name, computed before V12 signal filtering; current bin excluded

features.lower_wick_rank20: empirical percentile rank of current lower_wick_pct against previous20 same-bin values; rank=(count(prior<x)+0.5*count(prior==x))/20

cohorts.train_like: V12 candidate, prior-day gates, all 16 V15 features finite, date<2025-01-01, exit_date<2025-01-01 only for maturity membership; no return values read
cohorts.h1: same representation and gates, candidate date 2025-03-01 through 2025-06-30; no return values read

continuous: median shift normalized by train IQR

representation_gate.pass: zero severe features AND at most four moderate features
representation_gate.fail: do not open V15 strategy-return metrics; redesign representation outcome-free
representation_gate.if_pass: preregister a separate V15 supervised evaluation receipt before any H1 return metrics
